title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
abstract: arXiv:2610.32237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. The conventional strategies focused on price-based indicators are inadequate in capturing the market dynamism arising from real-world events such as social sentiments, political instability, or sudden economic shifts. With the rise of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and data availability, there is a requirement for more efficient algorithms that can incorporate these external factors in trading strategies. DRL has shown potential in simulating real-world scenarios and in simplifying complex decision-making since DRL agents can automate the trading process i.e. executing trades in a manner comparable to human traders. They have shown reliable performance since they can update their policies based on risk and quantitative factors

translated_title: 面向基于Actor-Critic智能体的金融情境丰富策略：一种用于股票交易的深度强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 在现代金融市场中，超过四分之三的大宗交易是由基于先进交易策略的算法交易执行的，其精度和速度均优于传统的人类交易者。传统的基于价格指标的策略不足以捕捉由现实世界事件（如社会情绪、政治不稳定或突然的经济变化）所引发的市场动态。随着深度强化学习（DRL）的兴起和数据的日益可用，人们需要更高效的算法，能够将这些外部因素纳入交易策略之中。DRL在模拟真实世界场景和简化复杂决策方面展现出了巨大潜力，因为DRL智能体可以自动化交易过程，即以与人类交易者相当的方式执行交易。由于它们能够根据风险和定量因素更新自身策略，因此表现出可靠的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向基于Actor-Critic智能体的金融情境丰富策略，利用深度强化学习方法将社会情绪、政治不稳定等外部因素纳入股票交易策略，以捕捉传统价格指标无法捕捉的市场动态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a financial context-rich strategy for Actor-Critic based agents, leveraging deep reinforcement learning to incorporate external factors such as social sentiments and political instability into stock trading strategies to capture market dynamics that traditional price-based indicators fail to capture.
